response.sql:
SELECT SUM(customer_rental_count) AS total_rentals
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_rental_count
  FROM rental
  WHERE CAST(return_date AS CHAR) >= '2005-07-13 08:35:51'
    AND CAST(return_date AS CHAR) <= '2005-08-09 05:58:16'
  GROUP BY customer_id
) AS per_customer;

assumptions.assumption: Rentals with NULL return_date are excluded because their return timestamp cannot fall within the stated range.
